Megan: Quick sync — can we consolidate owners + action items for console dashboards / tracing hooks / error analysis views / retention config? I want a single list to hand off to PMs by EOD Friday.
Rahul: I can own the dashboards. Quick Q: do we keep 30d traces by default or do we need 90d for compliance?
Olivia: I can take tracing hooks + instrumentations. Heads-up: the tracing lib bump to v1.4 changes the span names, so dashboards will need a small rewrite. PR: github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/4123
Sam: I can do retention config + infra rollout. We need consensus on S3 vs hotstore TTL for 90d — hotstore for 30d, move older to cold S3. That impacts cost.
Jess: Product prioritizes the error-analysis views + a high-level incidents dashboard. Need those live for the Q2 exec review (target: 2026-05-12). If dashboards depend on the new span naming, we should slot that before the review.
Megan: Ok owners: dashboards -> Rahul, tracing hooks -> Olivia, retention infra -> Sam, error-analysis views -> Jess. Can each of you reply with a one-line blocker and ETA? Also add a GitHub label `console-observability` to PRs.
Rahul: Blocker: span name changes + missing event.metadata fields (we need event.env). ETA: initial dashboard diffs by 2026-04-28. I'll open dashboard PRs under github.com/redwood/console-dashboards with #4189 as the first diff.
Olivia: Blocker: instrumentation bump requires a small migration script for legacy span names. I’ll draft the migration in the hooks repo and add tests. ETA: tracing hook PR by 2026-04-22. Migration script will be a follow-up (2026-04-30).
Sam: Blocker: need approval for 90d cold storage budget from finance and a Terraform plan review. I put up a draft TF change: repo github.com/redwood/infra-observability, PR #220. ETA: retention config changes merged by 2026-05-02 if budget approved.
Megan: Noted. Dependencies list I have so far: 1) instrumentation bump (Olivia) 2) event schema add event.env (backend) 3) TF retention plan (Sam) 4) dashboard changes (Rahul) 5) error-analysis queries (Jess). Add any missing.
Rahul: Add: alert rule renames in PagerDuty — teams need heads-up. I’ll send a short note to #incidents once dashboards PRs are ready.
Jess: For error-analysis views I'll need an updated sample of noisy error types from SRE (Sam?) and a list of top-5 customer flows to prioritize. Could someone paste that here?
Sam: I can export a short list of top-5 noisy errors from last 30d and drop it in this thread by EOD today.
Olivia: FYI deploy-bot just posted a canary log for instrumentations.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for instrumentation-service succeeded in staging — logs at https://deploys/redwood/inst/2026-04-15-02
Megan: Two small config diffs that should be consistent across repos — sharing snippet. Please copy into your PRs:
Megan: ```yaml
observability:
  trace_retention_days: 30  # default live window
  cold_storage_days: 90    # move to S3 after 30d
  export_bucket: "s3://redwood-observability-archives"
```
Megan: If anyone needs a different plan per customer tier, note it as a config override in the PR.
Rahul: Acked. I’ll use that YAML in the dashboards repo docs.
Olivia: Acked. I’ll add a migration note and a feature flag toggled in staging.
Sam: Acked. I’ll add TF var `observability_cold_days = 90` and request finance sign-off.
Jess: Acked — I’ll draft the error view queries and post examples by 2026-04-26.
Megan: Great. Action items recap (short):
- Rahul: dashboard PRs & PD alert rename note (ETA 2026-04-28)
- Olivia: tracing hooks PR + migration script plan (ETA 2026-04-22 / 2026-04-30)
- Sam: TF retention plan + finance approval (ETA 2026-05-02)
- Jess: error-analysis queries & sample prioritization (ETA 2026-04-26)
Megan: If anyone can't meet the ETA, ping here ASAP. I'll collate into a single tracking ticket and assign to eng-platform. Thanks :raised_hands:
